overview.title: A classic local spring stop
overview.p1: Source Vittel is known locally as an easy spring outing from Ifrane — fresh air and a mountain setting without a long hike. Facilities are simple.
overview.p2: For longer walks, combine it with the national park or the cedar forest.

q1.question: Is the water safe to drink?
q1.answer: Do not assume spring water is treated — bring drinking water.

q2.question: Is it crowded?
q2.answer: Weekends can be busier with local visitors.

q4.question: Is walking required?
